player_prompt.intro:
Ko a yi Jokkere {player_id} caggal IteratedTwoThirdsAverage rawaaji {num_rounds}.
Ko kala rawa, miɗo nammbere nde {min_guess} e {max_guess}.
Diga jokkere ɓe ɗiɗo, koɗume ɗo (2/3)kisa (nammbere jokkere ɓe ɗiɗo),
e jokkere joɗɗoɗo nammbere maɓɓe koɗume ɗo o heɓi rawa oo.
Amsa miɗo nammbere maa caggal '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format je wala naffuda; don na wi'a no a footi wurtinugo: [<number>].

message.round_guesses: Tooraa 0 tafaa nammba {guess0}; Tooraa 1 tafaa nammba {guess1}. Kadi takku ngal: {target}.
message.round_draw: Ko ɓe waɗi fuu ɗum boɗɗum.
